title: Descent of a finite qcqs etale covering
statement: Let $I$ be a nonempty directed preorder, $D:I^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathrm{Sch}$ a system of qcqs schemes with affine transition maps, and $c$ a limit cone with point $X$ [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions, def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Write $B_q$ for actual base change on small etale categories [def-weil-pbc-etale-site, def-pc-fibre-product]. Let $U$ be a qcqs etale object over $X$, $K$ a finite set (possibly empty), $V_k$ qcqs etale objects, and $f_k:V_k\to U$ a covering family. There exist $i_0\in I$, qcqs etale objects $U_0,V_{0,k}$ over $D_{i_0}$, arrows $f_{0,k}:V_{0,k}\to U_0$, and isomorphisms $e_U:B_{\pi_{i_0}}U_0\simeq U$ and $e_{V,k}:B_{\pi_{i_0}}V_{0,k}\simeq V_k$, such that $B_{\pi_{i_0}}(f_{0,k});e_U=e_{V,k};f_k$. For every $j\geq i_0$ put $U_j=B_{p_{ji_0}}U_0$, $V_{j,k}=B_{p_{ji_0}}V_{0,k}$, $f_{j,k}=B_{p_{ji_0}}f_{0,k}$. The family $(f_{j,k})$ covers $U_j$ for every such $j$. The conclusion contains no coefficient system or complex.

proof.text: The qcqs limit base and the qcqs etale sources imply finite presentation of the structure maps. Spread out U and the finite family V_k using 01ZM(1). Finite presentation over qcqs bases makes the models qcqs. Apply etaleness descent to each structure morphism and pass to a common upper bound, using pullback composition to retain the limit isomorphisms.
Apply morphism descent to the finitely many f_k with these fixed object identifications. Pass to a common upper bound, retaining the arrow equations and all qcqs properties.

The finite disjoint union of the covering sources is qcqs, and its arrow into U_0 is locally finitely presented. The covering assumption says its limit base change is surjective. Descend surjectivity to a later stage by 07RR. In the small etale topology this makes the descended family covering. In the empty-family case the source is empty and the same surjectivity theorem makes the target empty.
Every later family is an actual pullback of this stage family; base change preserves coverings. The affine transitions preserve the qcqs properties of the models. This gives all claimed properties.

theorem exists_etale_limit_finite_cover_descent
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)] [Nonempty I]
    (D : Iᵒᵖ ⥤ Scheme.{u}) (c : Cone D) (hc : IsLimit c)
    [∀ i : Iᵒᵖ, CompactSpace (D.obj i)] [∀ i : Iᵒᵖ, QuasiSeparatedSpace (D.obj i)]
    [∀ (i j : Iᵒᵖ) (f : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom (D.map f)]
    (U : c.pt.Etale) [CompactSpace U.left] [QuasiSeparatedSpace U.left]
    (K : Type (u + 1)) [Finite K] (V : K → c.pt.Etale) (f : ∀ k, V k ⟶ U)
    (hV : ∀ k, CompactSpace (V k).left ∧ QuasiSeparatedSpace (V k).left)
    (hf : Sieve.ofArrows V f ∈ c.pt.smallEtaleTopology U) :
    ∃ (i₀ : I) (U₀ : (D.obj (op i₀)).Etale)
    (V₀ : K → (D.obj (op i₀)).Etale) (f₀ : ∀ k, V₀ k ⟶ U₀)
    (eU : (MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ (c.π.app (op i₀))).obj U₀ ≅ U)
    (eV : ∀ k,
      (MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ (c.π.app (op i₀))).obj (V₀ k) ≅ V k),
    let J := {j : I // i₀ ≤ j}
    let B := fun j : J ↦
      MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ (D.map (homOfLE j.property).op)
    let Blim := MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ (c.π.app (op i₀))
    let Uj := fun j : J ↦ (B j).obj U₀
    let Vj := fun (j : J) (k : K) ↦ (B j).obj (V₀ k)
    let fj := fun (j : J) (k : K) ↦ (B j).map (f₀ k)
    (CompactSpace U₀.left ∧ QuasiSeparatedSpace U₀.left) ∧
    (∀ k, CompactSpace (V₀ k).left ∧ QuasiSeparatedSpace (V₀ k).left) ∧
    (∀ k, Blim.map (f₀ k) ≫ eU.hom = (eV k).hom ≫ f k) ∧
    (∀ j : J, Sieve.ofArrows (Vj j) (fj j) ∈
        (D.obj (op j.val)).smallEtaleTopology (Uj j))
